subject.title: fix: preserve zero model-call token telemetry

question: Should this PR ship the new openclaw.model_call.context_utilization span attribute as part of the zero-token telemetry fix after the correctness and proof gaps are addressed?
rationale: The zero-token preservation is a narrow bug fix, but the context-utilization attribute is a new operator-visible telemetry shape and the linked issue already carries maintainer/product-decision signals.

options.title: Approve Attribute With Repair
options.body: Keep the new context-utilization attribute, but require presence-aware token assignment, focused regression coverage, docs or PR-body schema context, and real exporter proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Zero Preservation
options.body: Remove the context-utilization addition from this PR and land only the explicit-zero token fix while tracking the new span attribute separately.

options.title: Hold For Telemetry Design
options.body: Pause this PR until diagnostics owners settle the attribute name, bounds, and documentation expectations.

recommendation.title: Approve Attribute With Repair
recommendation.body: Keep the new context-utilization attribute, but require presence-aware token assignment, focused regression coverage, docs or PR-body schema context, and real exporter proof before merge.
